history_refresh.title: Refresh project history
history_refresh.description: Rebuild the history index for the selected server and workspace. Current KCoder writes synchronize automatically. After manually editing history, or writing with an older KCoder version that does not register journal changes, refresh before relying on the indexed list.

usageHistory.description: Last 30 UTC calendar days, across projects on the selected target profile.

providerSettings.userScope: Manage user-level APIs here. Project and startup configuration is not deleted.

providerSettings.title: Models and API
providerSettings.description: Save to the selected KCoder target's user settings. Project and startup overrides retain their normal precedence.

Parameters apply only to this model, without changing other models under this API and override matching extension fields; model, messages, input, system, instructions, tools and stream cannot be overridden. Do not include API keys or credentials. Saving validates the model with these parameters; new conversations use the saved configuration.
providerSettings.extraBodyReserved: Extra request body cannot override the runtime-managed field {{field}}. Remove it and retry.
providerSettings.extraBodyInvalid: Extra request body must be a valid JSON object no larger than 64 KiB.
providerSettings.keyHelp: Enter your API Key above; no .env editing is needed. Saving writes the key to the selected runtime target’s credentials file, without displaying it in the list or storing it in the browser. Leave it blank to keep the existing key. Only save keys to trusted targets and protect their credentials files.
providerSettings.saved: Saved without changing running models. Apply the configuration when the target is idle.

Missed occurrences coalesce, undelivered tasks older than seven days expire, and recurring tasks have up to 30 seconds of deterministic jitter by default.

toolProfile.fullHelp: Includes skill discovery and activation tools, alongside the full built-in toolset.
toolProfile.coreHelp: Keeps core tools without autonomous skill discovery or activation. You can still select skills in Studio.

workflowCanvas.deleteConfirmation: Delete “{{title}}” and all its saved versions? This cannot be undone. Existing conversation run records are retained.
workflowCanvas.heading: Workflows
workflowCanvas.title: Title
workflowCanvas.unsupported: Upgrade the selected KCoder target to use the workflow canvas.
workflowCanvas.emptyLibrary: No workflows yet. Create a draft to begin.
workflowCanvas.selectWorkflow: Select a workflow or create a draft.
workflowCanvas.truncated: Sorted by update time; page order can change while drafts are edited.
workflowCanvas.emptyCanvas: Add a node manually, or describe a workflow and generate it step by step.
workflowCanvas.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft node? The last saved version is retained.
workflowCanvas.editorStale: The draft changed. Reloading replaces your unsaved node edits.
workflowCanvas.finishNodeEdit: Apply or discard the current node edits first.
workflowCanvas.saveDoesNotRun: Generating and saving only edit the definition; neither runs its nodes. Saving validates the DAG. Previously saved versions remain available. Generation and execution require the full toolset.
workflowCanvas.workspaceRequired: Choose the project path for generation or execution
workflowCanvas.generationFailed: Generation failed. Open the conversation for details.
workflowCanvas.generationSubmitted: Generation conversation submitted. Nodes appear as they are recorded.
workflowCanvas.generationCompleted: Generation completed. Review the draft before saving.
workflowCanvas.generationCancelled: Generation cancelled. Recorded draft nodes are retained.
workflowCanvas.scopeChanged: The target or account changed. Reload the workflow library.
workflowCanvas.composerHint: Generate a workflow through conversation in this project, without executing its tasks.
workflowCanvas.conversationHint: Make changes in chat; the canvas updates alongside it.
workflowCanvas.switchUnsupported: This target does not support named workflow routes. Update KCoder on the target server.
workflowCanvas.predicateDepth: Conditions support at most 8 nested levels.
workflowCanvas.switchHint: Select the first matching route in order; otherwise take the default route.
workflowCanvas.runInstruction: Use the saved workflow, reference: {{params}}. Read this exact saved version and determine arguments from this conversation. Ask me in chat for missing or ambiguous required information; do not guess or execute early. Once complete, run in this conversation and report the actual result.
workflowCanvas.nodeConfigHint: Reference /input or /nodes/dependencyId. Templates use {{/input/field}}. Agents accept outputSchema and validationRetries (up to 2); loops use mode, maxIterations (up to 10), and an optional until predicate.
workflowCanvas.invalidJsonObject: Enter a valid JSON object before saving.
workflowCanvas.noRuns: No runs yet. Generating or saving does not execute nodes.
workflowCanvas.runControlsHint: Cancel or resume in the original execution conversation. This view never resubmits completed nodes.
workflowCanvas.complexPredicate: This is a compound condition; edit it in advanced JSON configuration.
workflowCanvas.importTooLarge: Workflow files must not exceed 128 KiB.
workflowCanvas.readOnlyVersion: Historical version is read-only. Switch to the draft to edit.
workflowCanvas.runSettings: Run settings: project directory and arguments
workflowCanvas.codeHint: Read input and direct dependency results through input and nodes; return JSON data. No model calls, files, network or shell.
workflowCanvas.toolHint: Call an available session tool without a model. Existing permissions apply; authorize restricted actions before resuming.
workflowCanvas.toolBindingsHint: Set tool.arguments in the configuration below; tool.bindings maps argument names to values under /input or /nodes.
workflowCanvas.subworkflowHint: Choose a published workflow and pin its version. Map inputs through subworkflow.arguments and bindings; updates never silently switch versions.
workflowCanvas.waitHint: Set delayMs or untilUnixMs. Deadlines persist across resume; increase the overall workflow timeout for long waits.
workflowCanvas.humanHint: Pause this branch for a user response validated by responseSchema; timeoutMs bounds the wait.
workflowCanvas.eventHint: Wait for event data submitted by an authenticated client, validated by payloadSchema. No anonymous webhook is opened.
workflowCanvas.pendingHint: Resuming an interrupted run retains this request and its original deadline.
workflowCanvas.defaultHumanPrompt: Review the result and confirm whether to continue.
workflowCanvas.transformHint: Select data with sourcePointer. Up to 16 steps: map, filter, sort, deduplicate and limit. No model or code required.
workflowCanvas.loopBodyHint: Run the selected saved version each iteration. Map /iteration/item or /iteration/index to child inputs in advanced configuration.
workflowCanvas.failurePolicyHint: Automatic retries are limited to pure nodes and tools verified read-only by the runtime. Recovery branches inspect workflowError. Cancellation and resource limits still stop execution.
workflowCanvas.workspaceHint: Create in a conversation, refine on the canvas, and reuse a saved version.
workflowCanvas.recoveryInstruction: Continue this workflow using Workflow with these exact parameters: {{params}}. Preserve successful checkpoints, retry only unfinished or affected nodes, and inspect unknown effects before repeating them.

workflowReuse.hint: Choose a workflow, then describe your needs in chat. It runs after you send.
workflowReuse.empty: No matching saved workflows. Save a runnable version in Workflows first.
workflowReuse.objectRequired: Run arguments must be a JSON object.
workflowReuse.listLimit: The workflow list is too large. Manage workflows and try again.
workflowReuse.conversationInstruction: Use the saved workflow “{{title}}”, reference: {{params}}. Read this exact saved version first and determine arguments from this conversation. If required information is missing or ambiguous, ask me in chat instead of guessing or executing early. Once complete, run it in this conversation and report the actual result.
workflowReuse.conversationHint: Describe your requirements in chat. The model reads this version and asks for missing information; filling a form is optional.
workflowReuse.complexSchema: You can provide arguments in chat. Complex structures keep the JSON editor and are validated by the server when run.
workflowReuse.versionMismatch: The returned version does not match. Select it again.
workflowReuse.fixParameters: Correct the arguments, or collapse manual settings to provide them in chat.
workflowReuse.issue_extra: {{field}}: this version does not accept this argument.

workflowFlow.dismissCard: Hide this workflow card (keeps the workflow)
workflowFlow.needsInput: Waiting for information. Reply in chat; no nodes have started.
workflowFlow.runMismatch: The run does not match this conversation or selected version. Run state was not displayed.
workflowFlow.localEdits: Node edits are not applied yet. Save or discard them first.
workflowFlow.publishHint: Save a new version without changing saved versions or active runs.

imageFeedback.fileLarge: Image file is too large: {{size}} MiB; maximum {{max}} MiB. Resize or compress it before sending.
imageFeedback.large: Image dimensions are too large: {{width}} × {{height}} pixels. Maximum edge: {{maxEdge}}; maximum total: {{maxPixels}} pixels. Resize proportionally before sending.
imageFeedback.small: Image dimensions are small: {{width}} × {{height}} pixels; recommended shortest edge: {{min}} pixels. The image is still passed directly to model vision without OCR. Provide a clearer image if details are unreadable.
imageFeedback.invalid: Cannot read image dimensions. Use a valid PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP image.

workflowVerification.title: Version verification
workflowVerification.unsupported: This target does not support version verification records.
workflowVerification.unsaved: Save a version before execution verification.
workflowVerification.newDraft: New draft: execution unverified. Previous evidence belongs to its saved version.
workflowVerification.staticUnrecorded: No static check record for this version
workflowVerification.toolContractsUnverified: Some target tool contracts remain unverified.
workflowVerification.interactionModified: A user adjustment is recorded for this run; its application is determined by the Agent receipt. The saved definition is unchanged.
workflowVerification.model: Host context model at run start: {{model}}
workflowVerification.nearCapacity: Library capacity is nearly full. Existing history is retained.

check.modified_passed: Configured checks passed for this adjusted run; this does not prove unchanged saved-version reuse

workflowVerification.historyElsewhere: Historical verification records exist on other pages.
workflowVerification.scenarioUnrecorded: No declared scenario report was recorded.
workflowVerification.confirmationRequired: Review and explicitly confirm this storage or history operation.
workflowVerification.effectsUnknown: Some effects remain unconfirmed; history cleanup is blocked.
workflowVerification.latestProtected: The latest saved version is protected.
workflowVerification.historicalSnapshot: This exact historical snapshot is retained and is not published for new runs.
workflowVerification.archiveConfirmation: Remove version {{version}} from publication? Its exact definition, fingerprint and verification history remain in private historical snapshots. Referenced, current, active and unconfirmed versions are protected.
workflowVerification.migrationConfirmation: Retain an immutable backup and switch this library to separate draft/version objects. Older writers are blocked until compatible storage is restored.
workflowVerification.rollbackConfirmation: Restore the current library and retained history to a format compatible with older clients. The target checks version/count/byte limits first and retains all data if conversion is not representable.
workflowVerification.prepareExplanation: Review target, inputs and configured checks for saved version {{version}}. Continue to the conversation and send the prepared request to authorize actual execution.
workflowVerification.caseId: Case ID (ASCII letters, digits, hyphen or underscore)
workflowVerification.chooseCaseChecks: Choose the checks this finite input case must actually execute. Branch alternatives need separate cases.
workflowVerification.agentSnapshotsIncomplete: Actual Agent configuration summaries are bounded; configurations for remaining calls were not recorded.
workflowVerification.modelConfigurationHelp: Frozen admission snapshot and actual configuration of each Agent

phase.mounted: Components mounted; read-only availability check pending
phase.unknown: Runtime availability has not been checked

pluginActivation.unsupported: This execution target does not report runtime activation yet.
pluginActivation.privateHint: Credentials go directly to private storage on this execution target. Do not paste them into chat.
pluginActivation.privateUnsupported: Private credential setup is unavailable on this target. Update the target before configuring credentials here.
pluginActivation.nextTurn: Saved. These credentials take effect on the next turn or connection.
pluginActivation.failed: The check failed. Verify the target configuration and try again.
pluginActivation.revalidationFailed: The availability check failed. Review the details and try again.
pluginActivation.identityRequired: Check availability before entering credentials to confirm the current plugin source.

mcpReason.connectionFailed: MCP connection failed. Check the server command or endpoint, then retry on the next turn.
mcpReason.protocolFailed: MCP protocol negotiation or tool discovery failed. Check server compatibility and retry on the next turn.
mcpReason.authorizationRequired: MCP authorization is incomplete or rejected. Complete authorization for this server in MCP settings, then retry on the next turn.
mcpReason.noTools: MCP connected but no tools are mounted. Check the server tool list and plugin tool policy.
mcpReason.timedOut: MCP connection timed out. Check server availability and retry on the next turn.
mcpReason.unavailable: MCP is unavailable. Check the server configuration and retry on the next turn.

rpcReadTimeout: The read request timed out. You can read the latest state again.
rpcUnknownOutcomeTimeout: The request timed out before its receipt arrived. The server may still complete it. Check the latest state before submitting again.

workflowRunArchive.unsupported: This target does not support run history archival. Update the target to manage its history.
workflowRunArchive.retained: Archive selected completed runs to release observation capacity. Execution artifacts, checkpoints, verification evidence and saved version references stay available for recovery.
workflowRunArchive.release: Releases {{bytes}} bytes from the observation budget.
workflowRunArchive.archived: Archived {{count}} runs and released {{bytes}} bytes. Recovery artifacts are retained.
workflowRunArchive.recoveryPending: Archival committed for {{count}} runs. Publication is pending recovery; retry this archive receipt before starting another run.
workflowRunArchive.blocker_unknown_effects_or_missing_verif: Outcome is unknown or verification evidence is missing
